text.text_excerpt: The food was amazing. Big props to the chefs in the back. They make top tier food. My only suggestions is the floor was pretty sticky. Minor thing but for a small establishment that's really making moves in the city I'd suggest keeping the restaurant to top notch quality. They also got my fiancée's order incorrect. We ordered a grilled shrimp salad and they gave her a fried salmon salad. I mean technically, she ended up getting a deal I guess because the salmon costs more than the shrimp but she was really looking forward to the shrimp salad. Good people even better food. First time eating here and I must ask myself why have I waited so long. It closes at 7 so you better get there early. I would recommend the Rasta pasta it has a spice to it with the fried catfish. Only disappointment I had was the shrimp plate....it came with 6 small shrimp. Other then that The food was really delicious.

I tried PraLees for the first time today and the food was really good! Both of the guys who were working were very friendly and sweet. He explained the menu items before I chose. They're operating off of a limited menu for now, but it's still a lot of choices! I got the fried salmon (!) so good - I had never had or seen that before, Brussels sprouts, crawfish macaroni and salad. The salmon is great with the crawfish sauce from the Mac and the sauce for the Brussels sprouts is good too. They hd some praline cupcakes on the counter that looked delicious, but i didn't try one.
